recognize_zh: 緊貼骨小樑的病灶由梭形到卵圓形、胞質淡嗜酸性且透亮的細胞鬆散排列成片，伴隨纖維基質，與周圍含嗜酸性球的正常造血骨髓分界清楚，這是系統性肥大細胞增生症常見的骨小樑旁病灶。
features: Paratrabecular lesion abutting a bony trabecula
Spindled to ovoid cells with bland oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm
Loose fibrotic stroma within the lesion
Adjacent hematopoietic marrow with eosinophils and granulocytic precursors
Scattered small lymphocytes; no granulomas or atypical large cells
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a paratrabecular lesion composed of loosely arranged spindled to ovoid cells with bland oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm in a fibrotic stroma. The surrounding marrow is cellular with granulocytic precursors and conspicuous eosinophils. No granulomas or large atypical cells are identified. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis; confirmation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Granulomas contain plump epithelioid histiocytes and giant cells that are CD68-positive and tryptase-negative.
Myelofibrosis shows diffuse fibrosis with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and streaming, not a discrete spindle mast cell lesion.
Metastatic tumors show nuclear atypia and keratin or S100 positivity rather than tryptase/CD117 expression.

ddx.dx: Chronic eosinophilic leukemia / myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia
ddx.vs: These show diffuse eosinophilia without a compact spindle mast cell lesion and harbor PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangements.
